text:
maria_cs: Weekly health check — quick snapshot for Nebula (onboarding wk6). TL;DR: token ingest +12% WoW, throughput up but QoQ -3%, p95 latency drift to 420ms (+80ms WoW), yesterday 5xx spike, spend +8% WoW. Need enablement + renewal coordination.

maria_cs: Quick metrics (high level):
```
Account: Nebula (trial -> expected paid in ~2 wks)
Token usage (7d): 1.2M tokens (WoW +12%, QoQ -3%)
Throughput: 220 req/s sustained, peak 320 req/s during batch window
Latency p50/p95: 120ms / 420ms (p95 +80ms WoW)
Errors: 5xx rate peaked at 0.8% yesterday (baseline ~0.02%)
Spend: ~$3.6k/week (WoW +8%)
```

liam_ae: Thanks — flagged. Renewal outreach scheduled for Tue 10/27. @ruth_onboard can you run a targeted enablement and billing walkthrough before that? Also is the spend above forecast?

ruth_onboard: I can do Tue 10am PT. Will cover prompt batching, KV cache, and basic cost controls. I'll prepare a short deck and a recording.

noah_sre: I checked logs for the 5xx window (03:12-03:24 UTC). GPU OOM triggered fallback to the small-quant model; that caused increased latency + error retries. Snippet: 
```
[03:12:08] gpu0 OOM on seq_len=8192, fallback->model-x-small-quant
[03:12:09] request retry (1) id=... status=502
[03:14:35] fallback drain complete, resumed normal pool
```

ava_prod: Product note — fallback policy kicked in due to very large seq lengths. Recommend: enforce max_tokens_per_request=1024 for this account and enable prefix caching. I'll open a change to the fallback backoff so we don't cascade retries into 5xx bursts. @maria_cs can we test config on a dedicated pool first?

maria_cs: Action items: 1) Ruth — enablement Tue 10am PT (cover batching & cache); 2) Noah — add alert/graph for OOM-fallback rate + automated paging if >0.2% in 30m; 3) Liam — confirm renewal outreach + updated spend forecast; 4) Ava — PR for fallback backoff + account config proposal. Also capture customer ask: clearer weekly billing forecasts and a short playbook for prompt size.

liam_ae: I'll share an updated spend forecast and the renewal email copy by EOD. :thumbsup:

ruth_onboard: Prep notes for enablement — sample config I will demo:
```
max_tokens_per_request: 1024
batching: enabled (target_batch_size: 64, max_latency_ms: 50)
kv_cache: enabled
```

deploybot: Incident note: fallback policy updated at 2734568000 by noah_sre — rule change rolled to staging.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the Nebula account doc with these action items and flag renewal risk as MED->HIGH if spend keeps rising or 5xx repeats. Closing thread for now; will reopen if new spikes appear.
